prompt: A bakery operates an 8-hour shift producing croissants. The standard production rate is 60 croissants per hour. For the first 3 hours of the shift (peak hours), the production rate increases by 25% compared to the standard. For the remaining hours (off-peak hours), the production rate decreases by 10% compared to the standard. Of the total croissants produced, 70% are sold at the full price of $3.50 each, and 20% are sold at a discounted price of $2.00 each. The remaining croissants are discarded. What is the total revenue generated from croissant sales during this 8-hour shift?
